'''Hot chocolate''' was an exotic warm [[Chocolate/Legends|chocolate]] [[Milk/Legends|milk]] drink. It had many aficionados, some of the most famous being [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Skywalker had grown so fond of the drink that he had kept a secret stash of the pods used to make it aboard his [[Han Solo/Legends|brother-in-law's]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|freighter]].<ref name="TJK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> His wife [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] also enjoyed it. The Solo family, Han, Leia, and Allana had a tradition of drinking the beverage while watching the ''[[The Perre Needmo Newshour]]''.<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> Hot chocolate was frowned upon in [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] court and among smugglers, as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officials viewed the drink as plebeian, and the smugglers preferred strong [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverages.<ref name="Vision of the Future" /> After the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], hot chocolate became a rarity, because the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] had re-shaped seven of the eight [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that were home to the plant that produced the pods that were used to make it during the conflict.<ref name="TJK" />

==Preparation==
While most inhabitants of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] were used to their hot chocolate just coming out of a dispenser nozzle, quite a few were of the opinion that hot chocolate was best when made from scratch. Here were the instructions for doing so:
*Put several pods in a standard shipboard [[multiprocessor]] then set the multiprocessor to dry and powder.
*Wait until the multiprocessor chimes, add small amount of water and a lot of sweetener then set it to agitate and heat.
*Wait until the multiprocessor chimes, then add [[Milk/Legends|milk]].
*Instruct the multiprocessor to heat the hot chocolate slowly.
*Wait until the processor chimes; the hot chocolate is ready to be served.

A number of things were used to enhance the taste of hot chocolate:
*A sliver of [[Tang bark/Legends|tang bark]]. (aka cinnamon)
*A drop of [[orchid bean extract]]. (aka [[Vanilla/Legends|vanilla]])
*A dollop of [[mallow]] paste on top. (aka marshmallow)

==Behind the scenes==
Hot chocolate was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' galaxy by [[Timothy Zahn]] in his [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''. Zahn received some criticism for featuring a drink found on Earth in the novel, but noted that other real-world concepts such as [[falcon]]s had already become a part of ''Star Wars''.<ref name="20th Anniversary">''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''</ref>
